messages:
jade: Quick heads-up — running the new sample-app onboarding with JSON-mode + function-calling uncovered a parity issue between the Python and JS SDKs. Repro below, short timeline and logs attached.

jade: Repro steps:
1) call /generate with json_mode: true + function_call schema
2) python SDK does the call, gets a 401 on the first streaming chunk, refreshes auth, retries the request automatically
3) model response contains a function call -> python SDK posts function_call to user code twice (duplicate side-effect)

jade: Minimal snippet:
```python
client.generate({
  "mode": "json",
  "function_schema": {"name":"create_user","args":{...}},
  "stream": True
})
```

mike: ugh. do you have the logs from the client showing the retry + duplicate function payload? :eyes:

jade: pasted. note the sequence numbers and the function_call chunk arriving both before and after the retry: 
```
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:01Z - stream_chunk seq=12 payload={"type":"content","text":"...start"}
[WARN] 2026-03-18T14:02:01Z - http 401 during stream, refreshing token
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:02Z - retrying request with refreshed token
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:03Z - stream_chunk seq=1 payload={"type":"function_call","name":"create_user","args":"{\"email\":\"a@b.c\"}"}
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:03Z - user-handler invoked create_user -> side-effect executed
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:03Z - stream_chunk seq=13 payload={"type":"function_call","name":"create_user","args":"{\"email\":\"a@b.c\"}"}
[INFO] 2026-03-18T14:02:03Z - user-handler invoked create_user -> side-effect executed
```

nora: interesting — JS SDK doesn't retry streaming by default, right? it only retries idempotent non-stream requests. so it ends up invoking the function once?

jade: correct. js had one function_call chunk (seq 13) and only a single invocation. python's streaming retry layer replays buffered chunks after auth refresh which yields the duplicate function chunk.

sam: this is bad for onboarding sample-apps since the sample code does a DB insert in the function handler. New users hit duplicates.

mike: possible mitigations:
- suppress auto-retry for streaming in py SDK (configurable)
- dedupe function_call by op id in the SDK before invoking handler (but requires schema change or adding call id)
- make sample-app handlers idempotent (recommended for user code, but we should not rely on that)

nora: quick fix -> add a small server-side header to indicate original-message-id or include a call_id in function_call meta. But that changes protocol.

jade: for immediate patch I proposed setting python SDK default: retry_on_stream_401 = False and add a deprecation warning for older versions that rely on automatic streaming retries. Also raised a PR with tests that simulate a 401 mid-stream.

sam: can you drop the PR? I'll review. We should also update the sample-apps onboarding doc to mention this edge-case and show a safe handler pattern (idempotency token).

jade: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 (includes test + changelog note).

mike: also: we discovered JSON-mode strict schema validation was rejecting valid outputs if keys were ordered differently in the SDK helper that serializes args. The python helper uses OrderedDict now, js uses plain object -> validator flagged mismatch because it expected exact field ordering in the upfront schema-to-json example in docs.

nora: whoa, validators should not be ordering-sensitive. that's a docs/generator bug: the schema examples were baked with ordered fields. We should fix the schema serializer to use deterministic canonicalization (sorted keys) before validation and update both SDKs.

sam: actionable list?
1) jade -> land py SDK PR to disable streaming retry and add test (high).
2) nora -> patch schema validator to canonicalize keys (medium).
3) mike -> update sample-app onboarding docs to recommend idempotent handlers + show token pattern (low).
4) sam -> triage if we want protocol change to include call_id (discuss in arch sync).

deploy-bot: deployment to staging passed for sdk@pr-482 (2026-03-18T14:08:00Z) :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks all. can we also add a short note in the release notes for the SDK breaking behavior? some customers hit duplicate side-effects if they upgraded midstream.

jade: yes — added a changelog blurb in the PR and a short notify to customers Slack channel if we ship the default change.

nora: nice. follow-up: i'll open a tiny RFC for adding an optional call_id field in streaming events so function calls are dedupable by default.

sam: perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
